name: PGFN open data - Divida Ativa da Uniao (quarterly bulk files)
operator: Procuradoria-Geral da Fazenda Nacional (PGFN, Ministerio da Fazenda)
tier_rationale: Government body (A8 trusted): the federal tax attorney's office publishes the Divida Ativa da Uniao as open data; 'Tiers: PGFN, MTE and CVM trusted, BrasilAPI community' (P244 cond 7).

reliability.justification: Official quarterly extract of the federal debt register; a debt is common among legitimate companies (P244 cond 5: LOW context), and the extract lags the live register by up to one quarter.

divida_ativa.title: PGFN Divida Ativa da Uniao open data (Sistema SIDA / Previdenciario / FGTS quarterly zips), imported into a local index

terms.quote: Tiers: PGFN, MTE and CVM trusted, BrasilAPI community; CVM data share-alike obligations apply only if redistributed.

divida_ativa.notes: Quote: binding council text (P244 cond 7); research C0565 terms 'Open government data (PGFN)' (verified_live 200, directory index and 206 Range heads 2026-11-26). Quarter folders https://dadosabertos.pgfn.gov.br/{YYYY}_trimestre_{0Q}/ hold Dados_abertos_Sistema_SIDA.zip (1.44 GB; the non-previdenciario file is no longer called Nao_Previdenciario), Dados_abertos_Previdenciario.zip and Dados_abertos_FGTS.zip (';', ISO-8859-1). P244 cond 2: opt-in, a separate import (python -m v3lum.modules.brazil_public_data.pgfn_import, to be wired as `v3lum data update pgfn`) streams the zips into an on-disk SQLite index keyed by CNPJ root, never in memory and never mid-scan; natural-person rows are dropped at import unless --include-persons is passed with a recorded purpose; the CAPTCHA-protected listadevedores.pgfn.gov.br app is never used (rule 1). Used by br_cnpj_risk_lists.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G10-2 (P244 br_cnpj_risk_lists). Bulk files only, downloaded by the out-of-band importer with resumable Range requests (2 s between requests, one at a time); no scan-time request (the module is disclosure 'none'). No quota block: a few large files per quarter. .br host: Accept-Language pt-BR by default.
